lastCompletedStory.title: Sweep orphaned implement-blocked markers whose issueId is a closed/shipped issue

nextStoryContext: US-002 added sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker (src/commands/sidecar.ts, right after clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue): reads the .cam-implement-blocked.json marker, and when present, resolves its issueId (Number(marker.issueId), the stringified prd.issueNumber) against readBacklogFromMain(cwd, spawn) entries via numericIdSuffix(entry.id) (now exported from src/issues/backlog.ts, was module-private). Removes the marker only when a matching entry is found AND stage==='shipped' OR status==='abandoned'; leaves it untouched when no match is found (best-effort) or the match is still open. Wired at runSidecar startup (src/commands/sidecar.ts, right after writeSessionStartFn, before the container-ensure guard) via the new SidecarOptions.sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn (injectable, defaults to the real closure with real spawnSync) -- this placement runs strictly before buildSidecarLoopDeps/the poll loop, so it precedes both the auto-chain circuit-breaker read (loop.ts:2194) and any plan-preflight clean-tree check. clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue (the matching-current-issue clear on rearm) is unchanged. file-size-budget.json's src/commands/sidecar.ts ceiling was raised 2857->2920 (gate's split('\n').length count, not wc -l) with a dated _ref note for CAM-282/US-002.
